import polars as pl
CAP = 5000
cache = __import__('pathlib').Path.home() / '.cache/positron-atlas/datasets/trials/trials.parquet'
if not cache.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f'Run examples/09-clinical-trials.ipynb first (expected: {cache})')
full = pl.read_parquet(cache)
df = full.sample(n=min(CAP, len(full)), seed=42)
del full
